reviews.evidence: The AVG projection is delivery_date minus ship_date on each shipment, ignoring NULL delivery dates. Its unit is calendar days.
COUNT(*) is equivalent to counting distinct return IDs because returns has one row per return_id.
The count filters shipping_fee IS NOT NULL, making it equivalent to COUNT(shipping_fee) on the same shipment rows.
The inventory key is one product per snapshot. Counting distinct non-NULL and NULL groups on that key is equivalent to the two required per-snapshot counts.
